name: Shard Storm
shortDescription: Dodge five thousand glowing shards and graze them for points.
description: A bullet-hell survival game you host on your own site. One small ship, eight hand-built patterns (Lotus, Vortex, Rain, Twin Spirals, Comb, Pulse Rings, Scatter, and Wall), and a score that rewards flying as close to the shards as you dare. A run lasts sixty seconds; survive it and the storm speeds up for a high-score chase. Every graze throws sparks and raises your multiplier, and a hit plays out in slow motion before your score counts up. Drag with one finger on a phone, hold a second finger to slow time, or fly with the arrow keys on a desktop. Your name sits on the scoreboard, your ship flies in your color, and three looks (neon, ember, and ice) each come in a light and a dark version. Your best score and longest streak stay in your browser.
